title: osculating-circle-2d widget params
description: A self-contained 'drag a point along a curve, watch the osculating circle' engine. The author supplies a parametric plane curve via `function curve(t){ return [x,y]; }`. The reader drags a point P along the curve; the engine computes the curvature kappa(t) by central finite differences, draws the osculating circle (the circle of radius 1/|kappa| centred at the centre of curvature, that best hugs the curve at P) along with the tangent and normal, and reports t, kappa, and the radius of curvature rho = 1/|kappa|. The circle shrinks where the curve bends sharply and grows toward a straight line where it flattens. The renderer owns the curve sampling, the drag-to-nearest-t projection, the curvature/osculating-circle geometry, the readout, and Reset; the curve is author-supplied. The gesture is 'drag-along-curve' — direct manipulation of a point constrained to a curve, a dimension the corpus otherwise lacks. jsdom-safe: createSVGPoint/getScreenCTM run only inside the pointer handlers, never at init.

widgetId.description: DOM id for the outer <div class="widget"> wrapper. The Reset button derives its id from it (widgetId+'-reset').

svgId.description: DOM id for the <svg> drawing surface.

outputId.description: DOM id for the .readout the engine writes t, kappa, rho into.

hint.description: Optional hint in .hd > .hint. Should tell the reader to drag the point along the curve.

svgTitle.description: Accessible <title> inside the SVG. Defaults to title.

x0.description: Data x at the left edge. Default -3.2.

x1.description: Data x at the right edge. Default 3.2.

y0.description: Data y at the bottom edge. Default -2.6.

y1.description: Data y at the top edge. Default 2.6.

t0.description: Curve parameter at the start. Default 0.

t1.description: Curve parameter at the end. Default 6.283185307179586 (2 pi).

closed.description: Whether the curve is closed (t0 and t1 join). Affects drawing only. Default true.

initialT.description: Initial parameter of the draggable point. Default 0.6.

showEvolute.description: Whether to trace the evolute — the locus of centres of curvature as P sweeps the whole curve — as a faint dashed violet curve. The path is broken where the centre flies off (near inflections). Default false.

bodyScript.description: Author JS defining `function curve(t){ return [x, y]; }` — a parametric plane curve in data coordinates over t in [t0, t1]. The engine samples it to draw the curve and computes curvature by central finite differences. Must not start a timer.
